data.one_liner: Animated alert dialog widget for success, error, warning, confirm, and loading states
data.what_it_does: CoolAlert provides a simple API to show animated alert dialogs in Flutter. It supports custom text, titles, widgets, and animations via Lottie or Flare.
use_when: Want a confirm dialog with custom animation
Implement a loading dialog with animation
avoid_when: Building complex multi-step forms inside a dialog
Requiring advanced dialog customization beyond provided props
strengths: Easy to integrate with one line of code
Highly customizable animations and button behavior
Supports both Lottie and Flare animations
weaknesses: Limited to single-purpose dialogs, no form support
No built-in support for nested navigation inside dialog
Requires manual handling of dialog dismissal logic
